scoring_rule: per target, z-score each of the 27 features over numbers 1..40, then average each unordered 8-feature subset

multiple_testing.p_value_method: continuity-corrected normal approximation to number-level binomial hit counts; exploratory, not an exact test

guardrails: strict prior-only features; target draw excluded
all 40 numbers ranked before target scoring
best-per-target formula is retrospective/descriptive, not a prospective forecast
global Holm applied across all 15 shards and all formula×split×endpoint tests
finite eight-feature grammar only; higher-order, weighted, conditional and nonlinear formula families remain open
immutable freezes preserved; no automatic strategy promotion
